output.reason: Evidence states that the Reserve Bank of India (Pre-payment Charges on Loans) Directions, 2025 was withdrawn/repealed with effect from 2025-11-28 and that, as of 2026-11-23, it is no longer in force. It also provides the relevant UCB Responsible Business Conduct Directions, 2025 residual clause (para 261(5)) stating: “In cases other than those mentioned at paragraph 261(1) and (2) above, pre-payment charges, if any, shall be as per the approved policy of a UCB.” Therefore both parts of the claim are supported.
